asr_text: I want my daughter's high school to hold on to the phones, collect them all in the morning, give them back when school lets out. Until then, they stay handed in. Then I wouldn't be the only bad guy. We agreed that at night, she'd put her phone in a basket in the living room. My daughter didn't keep that promise. I took her phone away. The next morning, breakfast was quiet. All I could hear was the sound of dishes. I wanted her to stick to what we'd agreed. But after I took her phone, I was the one who couldn't look her in the face. I don't want another morning like that. It would help if I could see the school was doing the same thing. I'm tired of arguing every night. But I just want to push this onto the school. At work, I'm the one who makes the arrangements. At home, I want to get out of being the bad guy. I'm a dad asking the school to come to my rescue.
